title: Market sees next Fed hike in October, following Barr comments and hot inflation reading
summary: The market anticipates the next Federal Reserve interest rate hike to occur in October, a sentiment bolstered by recent comments from Fed Chair Jerome Powell and a concerning inflation report. S&P Global has indicated that its comprehensive inflation measure has reached its highest point since October 2022, raising alarms about the current economic climate. These developments suggest that inflationary pressures are persistent, prompting discussions about monetary policy adjustments in the near future.
